simple.meaning: to liken , i.e. (transitively) to use figurative language (an allegory, adage, song or the like); intransitively, to resemble
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מָשַׁל (H4911) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 16 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מָשַׁל (mâshal) means to liken , i.e. (transitively) to use figurative language (an allegory, adage, song or the like); intransitively, to resemble First listed occurrence: Ezek 12 23.

definitions.short: to liken , i.e. (transitively) to use figurative language (an allegory, adage, song or the like); intransitively, to resemble
definitions.usage: be(-come) like, compare, use (as a) proverb, speak (in proverbs), utter.
definitions.full: H4911. mashal I. [ מָשַׁל ] verb represent, be like (Arabic stand erect (compare Fl De Prov 1:1 ), II. effigiavit, representavit (rem alicui), see imitate, use a verse as a poverb ; description by way of comparison ; Assyrian mašâlu , Dl HWB 451 f. ; Ethiopic become like ; Aramaic מְתַל be like , compare ). Niph`al Perfect 3masculine singular נִמְשַׁל Psa 49:13 ; Psalm 49:21; 2 masculine singular נִמְֹשָׁ֑לְתָּ Isa 14:10 ; 1 singular נִמְשַׁלְתִּי Psa 28:1 ; 143:7 : — be like, similar , with אֶל Isa 14:10 ; עִם Psa 28:1 = 143:7 ; כְּ 49:13 ; Psalm 49:21. Hiph`il Imperfect 2masculine plural suffix וְתָמְשִׁלוּנִי compare Isa 46:5 . Hithpa`el Imperfect 1singular וָאֶתְמַשֵּׁל Job 30:19 (with כְּ ) and I have become like dust. . II. מָשַׁל verb denominative use of proverb, speak in parables or sentences of poetry , especially Ezekiel; — Qal Imperfect יִמְשֹׁל Ezek 16:44 ; 3 masculine plural יִמְשְׁלוּ 12:23 ; Imperative מְשֹׁל 17:2 ; 24:3 ; Infinitive construct מְשֹׁל 18:3 Participle משֵׁל 16:44 , plural משְׁלִים 18:2 ; Num 21:27 ; — use a proverb: מָשָׁל׳מ Ezek 12:23 ; 18:3 ; a parable with אֶלֿ 17:2 (|| חִידָה חוּד ), 24:3 ; with עַלֿ 18:2 , and ( מָשָׁל apparently omitted) יִמְשֹׁל עָלַיִךְ הַמּשֵׁל כָּלֿ הִנֵּה 16:44 (but this is awkward; point הַמָּשָׁל כֹּל הִנֵּה ); משְׁלִים Num 21:27 (JE)., Pi`el Participle הוּא מְשָׁלִים מְמַשֵּׁל הֲלֹא Ezek 21:5 is he not a maker of parables?
